\section{Strains that already exist\secstatus{todo}}\label{sec:exists}

Twelve singles and thirteen doubles were built and measured in run 4. No triple
has been constructed in any round.

\input{tables/t1-existing-singles}

\notesec{SPH1 is an open question}
\texttt{s11}, SPH1 (\gene{YLR313C}), is a built single that is part of no
triple, at a measured fitness of 1.0882 (Table~\ref{tab:existing-singles}). It
can ride along on the measurement plate as a near-wild-type control, or it can
be dropped. If it rides along, the plate carries 71 strains rather than 70, at
the same five wells each.

\input{tables/t2-existing-doubles}

All thirteen doubles go on the measurement plate. The pairs marked
\texttt{yes} under \emph{parent} are the starting strains for
Table~\ref{tab:new-triples}; the rest are re-measured alongside them, at no cost
in construction work and for a second reading on each of those pairs.

\notesec{One designed double was never built}
\gene{YJR060W} $\times$ \gene{YKL033W-A} does not exist: the transformation
produced no colonies. Both parent singles exist and were measured. The pair is
not part of the build list, and nothing in
Tables~\ref{tab:new-doubles} or~\ref{tab:new-triples} depends on it.
